label: Text to File
description: Store text as a file and emit its reference, for a node that takes a file (an upload, an attachment, an LLM conversation file) or to move text on as a file instead of a value. Plain text unless `mimeType` says otherwise. FileToText reads it back.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.label: Filename
inputs.description: Stored filename (what a download calls it).

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Store in
inputs.description: `run`: deleted with this run (once its record goes). `project`: deleted with the project, so it outlives the run. Any run can read it either way.

inputs.name: ttlDays
inputs.label: Deadline (idle days, empty or 0 = none)
inputs.description: The file is deleted once nobody has touched it for this many days (any read, download or link resets the count), or with its run or project if that comes first. Empty or 0: no deadline, it lives as long as its scope says.
